sampling_law.description: uniform over the published input box (the Level 0 study sheet's population, as EV5's), drawn by carbon.battery.seeds.make_batch

subgroups: the published important region reported separately

custody.made_on: the hidden host (the VM) only, as carbon-producer: seeds.make_batch from the hidden deployment's committed root, committed to its seed journal under the writer lock before any use (HIDDEN_HOST_SETUP section 6); never on the PC, never in the repository, never in a pool
custody.solved_on: the hidden host's CPU only (carbon.challenge_validator.tuning): never in a pod plan, rented compute, the attack knowledge store or a Graphite session; scored operator-side only, repeatedly, for score development

quiz_stratum.description: a near-limit quiz stratum drawn beside the 200 + 4 uniform main set, under this role at its own draw indices: Q2, the cases the registered disagreement panel splits most evenly on, from the near-limit pool of a uniform oversample; Q3, decision scenarios at uniformly drawn conditions (protected conditions redrawn), each a pre-solved 35-candidate grid judged by EV4's fixed rules, all-infeasible scenarios redrawn. Its private document's digest is committed to the same seed journal (kind quiz). Quiz cases never enter the main set's accuracy rows; the quiz feeds G-FEAS, G-PLATE, false-infeasible and Q3 decision measures only, and gates nothing until the owner adopts a rule
quiz_stratum.amendment: .agent/tickets/VALIDATOR-17_battery_tuning_set.md, 'Prospective amendment: a near-limit quiz stratum'; sizes and rulings in .agent/tickets/VALIDATOR-19_automated_batch_producer.md, 'Slice Q'
quiz_stratum.library: carbon/battery/value/quiz.py (q2_near, q2_select, q3_grid, q3_feasible, q3_judge; Q2_POOL_BANDS, Q2_N, Q2_POOL, Q3_K, PANEL_VERSION)
quiz_stratum.drawn_by: carbon/battery/quiz_stratum.py, through carbon.challenge_validator.tuning quiz-jobs, quiz-select and quiz-seal

decisions: OWNER-GRAPHITE-TEST-WAVE-08 §1: battery's tuning set, 200 cases plus 4 hidden duplicates, the Level 0 study sheet's population, sealed and solved on the operator's host CPU; no overlap with EV5, graphite-confirmation-v1, the rotating pool, TRAIN, PRACTICE or the practice decision set
OWNER-GRAPHITE-TEST-WAVE-05 §4: the Level 0 population is one uniform law with no strata (NONE_UNIFORM_LAW)

The owner, 2026-10-06 ('Yes make the quiz questions maximally effective'; VALIDATOR-19 slice Q, VALIDATOR-17's amendment): graphite-tuning-v1 is superseded unsealed by this v2, which adds the near-limit quiz stratum with the sizes agreed by Data Collection and the Test Lead

HIDDEN_HOST_SETUP section 6: sealed on the hidden host in the hidden deployment's journal; the rotating pool (tuning export-pool), EV5 and graphite-confirmation-v1 (confirmation export-prior on the PC, copied owner-only) are owner-only private priors, so no sealed role is regenerated on the hidden host

TRAIN and PRACTICE are checked as published cases (daemon.published_inputs) and every committed engineering-value study's decision cases as public_decision; the practice decision set (B4) is re-checked after the seal (tuning recheck), and on any overlap B4 is reselected, never the sealed tuning set
